title: Cave Point 101
why: Explains what riders are looking at; geology plus safety. Shareable, evergreen.
hook_options: Cave Point is 400 million years old.
Read this before you stand on the ledge.
caption: Cave Point's ledges are Niagara Escarpment dolomite, about 400 million years old, and Lake Michigan waves carved the caves. It's a small county park with a huge view. Stay back from wet rock, and skip the cliff jump. #CavePoint #DoorCounty #NiagaraEscarpment #LakeMichigan

slides.headline: What you're actually looking at.
slides.body: The rock, the caves and the rules. Read this before you stand on the ledge.

slides.headline: Dolomite from an ancient sea.
slides.body: The ledges are Niagara Escarpment dolomite, the same rock ridge that runs under all of Door County.

slides.headline: About 400 million years.
slides.body: The rock formed under a warm, shallow sea. Fossils in it are how geologists date it.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Cave Point ebike/IMG_2571.JPG

slides.headline: Waves did the carving.
slides.body: Lake Michigan waves pounded cracks in the rock, and freezing water pried them wider every winter.

slides.headline: About 19 acres, 900 feet of shore.
slides.body: Small county park, big view. It's county land, not part of the state park next door.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Cave Point ebike/IMG_0613.JPG

slides.headline: Open 30 minutes before sunrise.
slides.body: Door County parks close at 11pm. Picnic tables and grills are on site.

slides.headline: Wet rock is slick rock.
slides.body: Ledges get slippery when wet or icy, and lake weather turns fast. Keep a step back from the edge.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Cave Point ebike/IMG_2577.JPG

slides.headline: Skip the cliff jump.
slides.body: Emergency Services warns about shallow water, big waves and swift currents here. No lifeguards, either.

slides.headline: Ancient rock. Wave-cut caves. Watch your step.
slides.body: See it from the top, take your time, and let the waves do the showing off.

slides.kicker: Save this for your Cave Point trip
slides.headline: Ride out and see it yourself.
slides.body: About 4 miles from our Jacksonport shop by e-bike. Book at doorcountykayaktours.com.
